resources.string: Your inbox sorts itself by importance: Needs reply, Important, Can wait, Promotions — as clear tiles.
Detects scam emails right on your device and warns you with a red border — no data leaves your phone.
Reminds you of open questions in your mailbox — and when you\'ve been waiting too long for a reply yourself.
Real-time push with quick reply straight from the notification.
Multiple mailboxes with their own colors — separately or combined.

Summarize, draft replies and daily overview. Runs via the BlockMail server — contents are not stored there. Try it free for 3 days, then €5.99 per month with 150 AI requests or €10.99 with 300 requests.

Got a contract as a PDF? Open it, sign with your finger, send it straight back as a reply — no printer, scanner or second app. Plus a full PDF editor: highlight, redact, checkmarks, date stamps, rotate pages. You can even set BlockMail as your default PDF app. Part of BlockMail Pro.
Based on the %1$d currently loaded emails.
Attachments appear here once the corresponding email has been loaded — preloading runs automatically in the background.
Select an email on the left
The AI search answers free-form questions like "How much did I spend at Amazon?" — and finds years-old emails too.

BlockMail Pro includes every AI feature — AI search, summaries, daily overview, drafting replies and emails, proofreading — plus the full PDF editor: sign, highlight, redact, reorder pages, print — even for PDFs from other apps, including as your default PDF app. Pick your plan:
Every AI action counts as one request: asking your mailbox, summarizing a mail, the daily overview, drafting a reply, writing a mail with AI, and proofreading.
Get more out of your mailbox

With BlockMail Pro you can ask your mailbox anything (\"How much did I spend at Amazon?\") — and you get a full PDF editor: sign, highlight, redact, print. Even as the default app for every PDF on your phone. Free for 3 days.
You have used all %1$d AI requests for this month. Everything else in the app keeps working — until then the search bar acts as a plain text search.
Free for 3 days, then billed monthly through your Google Play account — cancel anytime. Unused requests expire at the end of the month.

Ask the AI free-form questions in the search bar – for example “How much did I spend at Amazon this month?”. Enter starts the AI; it searches your mailbox and reads the matching mails when needed. Part of BlockMail Pro.
Swipe a mail left or right: mark as read, snooze, archive, or delete. You choose what each gesture does in the settings.
Use the sun/moon icon to switch between light and dark. The palette next to it cycles through the app’s color schemes.
The left icon switches directly between list and tiles. Next to it, the menu — open right now: light/dark, view, plain design, font size, and the settings.

BlockMail warns you about phishing, reminds you of unanswered mails with the reply radar, shows statistics — and is a complete PDF editor: sign, highlight, redact, reorder pages. You can even set BlockMail as your default PDF app. You’ll find all extras in the settings.
Tap the pen to start a new email — the AI can help you phrase it if you like.

The AI button summarizes your whole day or all unread mails at a glance. All AI features are part of BlockMail Pro: try it free for 3 days, then from €5.99 per month (150 AI requests) or €10.99 (300 requests).
Images, PDFs and documents from every email gathered in one gallery — find, open and share them without hunting for the email.

Tap the folder name: this is where you switch folders and accounts — and find “Attachments”. Images, PDFs and documents from every email are gathered there in one gallery. Tapping an attachment inside a mail also offers “Sign & send back”.
Scroll and pinch to zoom. Tap an element to select it — then move it, resize it or delete it.
Tap an empty spot to place the signature. Tapping an existing element selects it — move, resize or delete it.
Draw your signature once — after that it stays saved on your device.
This PDF is protected and cannot be edited. Many banks encrypt their documents — then only opening and forwarding works.
Enter the password you use to open this document. It is only used to unlock it and is not stored.
Drag across the text to highlight it.
Tap an element to remove it.
Drag a rectangle over the area you want to redact.
Tap an empty spot to place the mark. Tapping an existing element selects it.
Tap an empty spot to place the date. Tapping an existing element selects it.
When saving, redacted pages are converted to images so the text underneath truly disappears. Text on those pages can no longer be selected afterwards.
The last page cannot be deleted.
The document editor is part of BlockMail Pro. Open BlockMail and start the free trial — after that you can view, sign and edit PDFs right here.
Sign with your finger. It is stored on your device and ready for every document from then on.
